mapper.sql: SELECT p.prj_id,p.prj_no,p.prj_nm,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,p.bsn_part_id, b.bsn_part_nm AS part_name,d.dev_nm AS pm_name,p.init_cntrct_amt,p.cur_cntrct_amt, p.trgt_cst_amt,p.trgt_mrgn_rt,m.actl_prgs_rt, coalesce(p.prfm_bgn_dt,p.cntrct_bgn_dt) AS bgn_dt, coalesce(p.cur_end_dt,p.cntrct_end_dt) AS end_dt FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON b.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT w.actl_prgs_rt FROM prj.wkly_memo w WHERE w.prj_id=p.prj_id ORDER BY w.wrt_dt DESC,w.memo_id DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true
mapper.select: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT l.dev_id,l.line_ty_cd,m.aloc_ym,m.mm_qty, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY m.aloc_ym ORDER BY CASE l.aloc_stg_cd WHEN 'ACTUAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'FINAL' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS priority FROM prj.tk_aloc_line l JOIN prj.tk_aloc_mth m ON m.aloc_line_id=l.aloc_line_id WHERE l.prj_id=#{id} AND m.aloc_ym > #{through} ) SELECT r.aloc_ym AS month,r.dev_id,r.mm_qty,s.indv_lbr_cst_amt AS monthly_cost FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.indv_lbr_cst_amt FROM cst.mth_cst c WHERE c.dev_id=r.dev_id AND c.cst_ym <= #{through} AND c.cst_ym >= to_char(to_date(#{through} || '-01','YYYY-MM-DD')-interval '2 months','YYYY-MM') ORDER BY c.cst_ym DESC LIMIT 1 ) s ON true WHERE r.priority=1 AND r.line_ty_cd='PERSON' ORDER BY r.aloc_ym,r.dev_id

SELECT DISTINCT d.dev_id,d.dev_nm FROM mst.dev d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=#{id} AND a.dev_id=d.dev_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cst.cst_aloc c WHERE c.prj_id=#{id} AND c.dev_id=d.dev_id) ORDER BY d.dev_id
